get.description: Managed public or private storage; private-access links last 600 seconds and the legacy path uses 300 seconds. Use the returned expires_at. Expiry applies to this signed link, not the underlying public URL or stored object. Never fetches customer buckets. Unknown is not proof recording was off.

allOf.description: Draft batch 2 contract. No required create fields. New create defaults: dynamic_greeting true, max_call_duration_seconds 300, silence_hangup_seconds 10, timezone valid account zone or UTC. Explicit valid values win. No existing agent is migrated. call_retention_days is rejected on create: account inheritance. Mixed unknown keys return warnings; unknown-only requests fail. Update is partial, never applies create defaults; empty updates fail. Pickup unchanged.

get.description: Your calls, newest first. Returns a bare array.

items.description: A call record. Post-call fields (transcript, summary, recording) populate after the call ends. Full field list: https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/get

duration_ms.description: Connected time in milliseconds. Not necessarily AI billed time: use the billing view for existing settled proof.

ended_reason.description: Why the call ended: completed, transferred, voicemail_detected, silence_timeout, speech_unrecognized (the caller spoke but nothing could be understood - usually another language), ivr_timeout, max_duration_reached, caller_hangup (inbound), callee_hangup (outbound), busy / failed / no-answer / canceled (carrier words), concurrency_limit, or a rare infrastructure ending.

charged_minutes.description: Minutes actually charged. Transfers stop the meter at handoff, so this can be less than the recording length.

parameters.name: phoneNumber
parameters.description: Owned public E.164 number. URL-encode the plus.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Calendar days including today, not rolling hours. All means retained history.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: IANA zone such as Europe/London, or UTC. Match the dashboard browser zone.

200.description: Complete aggregate; never truncated partial totals.

period_start.description: Inclusive boundary; null for all retained history.

minutes.description: total_ms / 60000, rounded to six decimals. total_ms is authoritative.

total_cost.description: Exact decimal USD sum of retained calls.cost. No repricing. Display to two decimals to match the dashboard.

unpriced_calls.description: Retained calls where cost IS NULL, not zero.

web_chats.description: Distinct session IDs with messages in the period, bound to the current number row and owner.

unused.description: Zero calls AND zero SMS in this period; web chats do not affect this field.
